The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin lambskin molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the leather cord pulled snug through the gold eyelets and the small gold skull charm swinging at her hip, fine stretch creases and a soft satin leather sheen. Background: a bright art museum atrium with a pale stone floor, tall blank white walls, a wide staircase of standard steps and a normal-height doorway, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
